0022600121.text: The Celtics (1-1) host the Chicago Bulls (1-2) in Boston's third game of the season, with Boston currently 8th in the East and 3rd in the Atlantic, 1 game back, while Chicago sits 11th in the East and 4th in the Central, 2 games back. Devin Carter is out for Boston with an illness, while Chicago has Nic Claxton out with a hamstring injury and lists Noa Essengue (head bruise) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness) as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Boston won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 124-105 win in Boston on February 11, 2026.
